title: Average items per order
statementMd:
On average how many units does an order contain? Round to 2 decimals (orders with items only).

Expected columns: `avg_units`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS avg_units FROM o;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
